name: lumen
description: Copiloto de IA para desktop (macOS, Windows e Linux): escuta a conversa, entende a tela e age sobre o texto selecionado.

scripts.dist: bash build/create-cert.sh && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 -c.directories.output="$HOME/Library/Caches/Lumen-build"
scripts.install:mac: osascript -e 'quit app "Lumen"' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; killall Lumen 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /Applications/Lumen.app && ditto "$HOME/Library/Caches/Lumen-build/mac-arm64/Lumen.app" /Applications/Lumen.app && open /Applications/Lumen.app
scripts.app: npm run dist && npm run install:mac
scripts.dist:universal: npm i --no-save --force sherpa-onnx-darwin-x64@2.0.1 sherpa-onnx-darwin-arm64@2.0.1 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --universal -c.directories.output="$HOME/Library/Caches/Lumen-build"
scripts.reset:perms: tccutil reset ScreenCapture com.willian.lumen; tccutil reset Accessibility com.willian.lumen; tccutil reset Microphone com.willian.lumen; tccutil reset AppleEvents com.willian.lumen; true
scripts.dist:win: npm i --no-save --force sherpa-onnx-win-x64@2.0.1 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm i --no-save --force sherpa-onnx-linux-x64@2.0.1 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --x64
